source_snapshot.test_name_items: Reject Bios FW Downgrade with Corrupt Image
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power off SUT.
2. Trying update the BIOS by the XXX_signed.rom file which is lower than current version and observe

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Downgrade the BIOS by *.rom file should not success.
BIOS ver should not change in webUI.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: corrupt/older BIOS-RoT image, curl and BMC credentials
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Combines corrupt and lower-version rejection; generic mc info/task description.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; notices combined negative conditions but lacks exact UI and BIOS-version evidence.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds artifact provenance, reject-before-write and independent state checks.
historical_reviews.round_02: PARTIAL due UI negative firmware attempt.

original_test_intent: Attempt a BMC webUI BIOS-RoT downgrade using an image described by the title as corrupt and by Procedure as lower than current, confirm rejection before programming and prove the BIOS version remains unchanged.
original_method: Preserve the dual-condition ambiguity, require the owner to define whether rejection is testing corruption, anti-rollback or their combination, validate artifact metadata, then have an engineer execute/observe the exact webUI path with reject-before-write and unchanged-state evidence.
manual_activity: An engineer must approve the negative condition, submit it in the BMC webUI and observe rejection plus unchanged displayed version. Agent artifact checks and independent inventory cannot replace the UI core.
required_inputs: Owner ruling on corruption, lower-version/anti-rollback or combined stimulus
Exact board/current version and test-image version/hash
Documented corruption method if corruption is in scope
Expected webUI validation/error phase and unchanged-version field
Stable power, off-state policy, console/OOB recovery and approval
safety_requirements: Do not assume an older signed image is corrupt or that a corrupt image proves anti-rollback.
Submit only via required webUI and stop if validation passes or programming begins.
Do not interrupt an active write; preserve task and console evidence.
No automatic retry, new corruption, alternative image/API or power-cycle.
Verify unchanged BIOS-RoT through UI and independent inventory plus platform health.
agent_execution_scope: Expose the ambiguity and validate the owner-selected artifact/property, baseline and recovery readiness.
Assist capture of webUI task/error and independently compare firmware/health evidence.
Prepare Tool Result without attributing rejection to an unproven mechanism or issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Define/approve the negative property and perform the webUI submission while SUT is off.
Observe reject-before-write and unchanged UI version; direct recovery if programming starts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its generic `mc info` cannot prove BIOS version or webUI rejection phase and conflates two distinct validation mechanisms.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Keep the source webUI core; use independent FirmwareInventory only as a post-check and do not invent a Redfish upload.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Title's corrupt condition, Procedure's lower-than-current condition, power-off, webUI observation, unchanged-version criterion and 5/20-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: After owner selection, use a single controlled negative variable where possible, capture explicit pre-programming error and unchanged version/health, and keep corruption and anti-rollback evidence distinct.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: BMC/BIOS-RoT platforms with documented validation and anti-rollback behavior.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC/BIOS-RoT/webUI builds, artifact version/hash/signature and browser.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds causal separation and artifact provenance without replacing webUI.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Current combined stimulus cannot independently prove both rejection mechanisms.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Owner decision on intended negative property.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A combined corrupt-and-old image can be rejected for either reason, so failure attribution is impossible without separate cases.

project_override_considerations: A project may split this into corrupt-image and valid-older-image tests. If kept combined, it must not claim independent coverage of both validation mechanisms.
expected_evidence: Owner-defined negative objective, board/current version and image version/hash/corruption metadata
Engineer-captured webUI upload/task and explicit reject-before-write error
Unchanged UI and independent BIOS-RoT version plus health/events

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title requires a corrupt image, while Procedure only specifies a lower-version `XXX_signed.rom` and Criteria only require downgrade rejection. The source does not establish whether corruption, anti-rollback or both are under test.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The combined negative case is still safely reviewable and manually executable after a case-specific owner ruling; it is not classified BLOCKED because no automated destructive sequence is being inferred.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its warning but separates corruption from lower-version policy and rejects generic readback.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains all safety/evidence controls and adds explicit source-conflict attribution; MANUAL ONLY reflects UI core.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Records NEED_ENGINEER_DECISION without stopping unrelated review or creating a global policy.

review_improvement: Prevents a single rejection from being double-counted as both corruption validation and anti-rollback coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Corrupt-content validation and version anti-rollback are different controls. The source combines them inconsistently; the case can proceed only with scoped owner interpretation and human UI acceptance.

source_provenance.history: review_round_02_functionality.md exact-code entry and repository exact-code search

no_automatic_retry: Do not resubmit, change image properties, switch update path or perform recovery/power actions automatically.

engineering_decision_update.approved_interpretation: Corrupt-image rejection and downgrade/anti-rollback rejection are separate mechanisms and separate evidence checkpoints; the project may select one or both but cannot cross-credit a single rejection.
required_checkpoints: separate logs/status for each selected mechanism
